description: List individual issues from a crawl, filtered by severity, issue key, category or URL prefix, as bseoa.issue/v1 records with the affected URL, the localized message, a fix hint and a docs link. Returns at most 100 issues per call: when the response has a non-null next_offset there are more, so call again with offset set to that value. Narrow with min_severity or key from issues_summary rather than paging through everything.

category.description: Only return issues in this category, e.g. "metadata", "links", "images".

key.description:
Only return issues with this exact key, e.g.
"metadata.missing_meta_description". Get keys from issues_summary.

limit.description: How many issues to return. Capped at 100 per call.

min_severity.description:
Only return issues at this severity or above: "low", "medium", "high",
or "critical".

offset.description:
Zero-based index of the first issue to return. Pass the `next_offset`
from the previous response to page through a large result set.

session_id.description: Crawl session id from list_crawls. Omit to use the most recent crawl.

url_prefix.description:
Only return issues for URLs starting with this prefix, e.g.
"https://example.com/blog/".

name: query_issues
